verdict.rationale: Continuous watchlist re-screening is a fair question for a KYC and identity-verification product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no sanctions/PEP watchlist screening and no ongoing monitoring of previously verified users. The documented webhooks fire only on verification-session status changes, and the blocklist only blocks reuse of a known document; both are adjacent features, not watchlist re-screening.

support.subject: As an ops lead, screening is not one-shot — previously verified users are continuously re-screened against watchlist updates, and changes raise events I can act on
